metadata.name: GetCo-signerDetails
metadata.description: Purpose of this API is used to get the Cosigner's details.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Allowable Values: 25

response_fields.name: CeaseAndDesistCommunication
response_fields.description: Values: All Communication Litigation Phone and Email Phone and Mail Email and Mail Phone Only Email Only Mail Only ATTO Allowable Values: 20

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: CustomerID
children.description: Unique ID associated with Customer Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xxxx Example: abc2123 Allowable Values: 25

children.name: CosignerTitle
children.description: Cosigner's Title like MR or MRS. Valid Values:Refer Appendix section 5.7 Format: xx Example: 01 = MR, 16 = Col, 17 = Judge Allowable Values: 15

children.name: CosignerFirstName
children.description: Cosigner's First Name Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:User1 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CosignerMiddleName
children.description: Cosigner's Middle Name Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:User1 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CosignerLastName
children.description: Cosigner's Last Name Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:User1 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CosignerCity
children.description: Cosigner's City. Allowable Values: 25

children.name: CosignerState
children.description: Cosigner’s State Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:abcd Allowable Values: 25

children.name: CosignerCountry
children.description: Cosigner’s Country Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:abcd Allowable Values: 15

children.name: CosignerPostalCode
children.description: Cosigner’s Postal code Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:99501 Allowable Values: 9

children.name: CosignerHomePhoneNumber
children.description: Cosigner's Home Phone Number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example:7548264758 Allowable Values: 11

children.name: CosignerWorkPhoneNumber
children.description: Cosigner's work phone number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example:784565412 Allowable Values: 11

children.name: CosignerMobileNumber
children.description: Cosigner's Mobile phone number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example:784565412 Allowable Values: 11

children.name: CosignerOtherPhoneNumber
children.description: Cosigner's Other phone number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example:784565412 Allowable Values: 11

children.name: CosignerFaxNumber
children.description: Cosigner's Fax number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example:784565412 Allowable Values: 11

children.name: CosignerCreditFilePhone
children.description: Cosigner's Credit File Phone number. Allowable Values: 11

children.name: CosignerAlternatePhone
children.description: Cosigner's Alternate phone number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example:784565412 Allowable Values: 11

children.name: CosignerEmailID
children.description: Cosigner's email ID associated with additional address details Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: [email protected] Example: [email protected] Allowable Values: 30

children.name: CosignerDateofBirth
children.description: Cosigner’s Date of Birth Valid Values: Format:MM/DD/YYYY Example:01/02/1988

children.name: CosignerResidenceType
children.description: Cosigner residence type Valid Values: Refer Appendix section 5.15 Format: xxxx Example: Own Allowable Values: 10

children.name: CosignerBadAddress
children.description: Identifies the Cosigner's provided address is a bad address. Valid Values:0 or 1 Format: x Example: 1

children.name: CosignerMaritalStatus
children.description: Cosigner's Marital Status Valid Values: 0,1 Format: x Example: 0- No, 1 - Yes Allowable Values: 1

children.name: CosignerSSN
children.description: Cosigner’s Social Security Number Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example:XXXXX8796 Allowable Values: 12

children.name: CosignerGender
children.description: Gender of Cosigner Valid Values: A-Z Format: xxxxxxx Example: Male Allowable Values: 5

children.name: CosignerCeaseAndDesist
children.description: This tag reflects whenever Cosigner is ceased or desist the CoreCOLLECT user need not follow up the mapped account holder thus all the credentials of the mapped account holders are erased from the dialer file using this flag. Valid Values: 0 or 1 Format: x Example: 1 Allowable Values: 1

children.name: CosignerBankruptcy
children.description: Cosigner's Flag for Bankruptcy Valid Values: 0,1 Format: x Example: 0-no, 1-yes Allowable Values: 1

children.name: CosignerBankruptcyNotificationDate
children.description: Cosigner's bankruptcy notification date. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:12/20/2019 12:18:19

children.name: CosignerDeceased
children.description: Flag to mark deceased.

children.name: CosignerDeceasedNotificationDate
children.description: Date when deceased is notified Format:MM/DD/YYYY Example:02/20/2020 Condition: Mandatory for deceased account

children.name: CreditFilePhoneTechType

children.name: AlternatePhoneTechType

children.description: CosignerConsumerInformationIndicator Allowable Values: 15

children.description: This tag reflect the co-signer Mobile carrier company Valid Values:A-z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXX Example:Vodafone Allowable Values: 25
